name: My Pet Alchemist
original_name: マイペットアルケミスト
source:
Alchemist Michelle sells illegal glaze to a shady merchant. How is it possible to stop her? One option is to drawn Michelle into the abyss of insult ... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
炼金术士米歇尔把非法釉料卖给可疑商人。怎样才能阻止她？其中一种方法，是把米歇尔拖入侮辱的深渊……
